implementation.engine: Static source-bound copy of registered native engine with narrow Modulation10 hooks; untagged/non-opt-in calls delegate to original exported functions.
implementation.shared_helpers: Use original contracts, policy, reservations, chronology and Modulation9 exit math under verified bindings; bridge ledgerAudit/summarize retain exact frozen implementation.
implementation.source_integrity: Verify fixed old registration SHA and all 47 source SHA values before studies; verify new files via a new registration.

signal_contract.at: Safe integer inside a declared session, not hardcoded to 60/90 minutes; sourceAvailableAt<=at.
signal_contract.plannedEntryAt: Exactly the native causal next supported five-minute opening from planSignalEntryAt(at,sessions); still before close-5 minutes.
signal_contract.causality_scope: Bridge verifies declared receipt clock and native causal reference; generator prefix invariance must verify that indicators use no future information.

api.input: Same dataset/protocol/signals-by-entry/variants shape as Modulation9; variants retain {id,entry,exit,risk}.
api.options: researchModulation10=true plus native NATIVE_MAX contract; internal profit8Trace=true. Modulation10 metadata without opt-in rejects.
api.costs: NOMINAL/STRESS definitions must exactly match the registered Modulation9 cost assumptions.
api.output: Same account/curve/trades/summary/event_risk fields plus source binding, entry clock mode and receipt policy.

isolated_ablation.single_changed_component: One pending stop overwritten as native versus retained pending-stop queue applied only after knownAt.
isolated_ablation.native_math: Invoke frozen native nextTrailingStop for native profiles in both receipt modes, not a newly approximated formula.
isolated_ablation.variant_ids: NATIVE72 versus NATIVE_QUEUE72 with same entry family and risk; only stop receipt mechanism differs.

multiple_signals.requirements: Unique IDs, nondecreasing decision timestamps, deterministic tie order, causally known close before reopening.
multiple_signals.same_symbol_simultaneous: Remains refused via SYMBOL_BUSY; no pyramiding or implicit netting.
multiple_signals.receipt_priority: Do not release partial campaign reservations early; release only at observed terminal close as original.
multiple_signals.study_scope: New MOM family limited to one best-asset nomination per session by protocol.entry_schedules; generic engine capability retained and fixture-tested, not added as an economic variation.

hardcoded_constraints: assertProfit8Signal permits only session.open+60m+1s, or 60/90m+1s for Modulation9.
planSignalEntryAt supports arbitrary safe integer decision timestamps but entry must precede close-5m.
planCalendarHolding accepts 24/48/72h, anchors deadline at signal.at and uses calendar, not future bar existence.
Profit8 native admission rejects a planned deadline later than the evaluation terminal.
Only long cash shares, ALPACA_PROXY, pointValue=1, NATIVE_MAX and common 30bp IOC are retained.
Funded portfolio itself has no one-signal-per-day cap; generator scheduling and the fixed clock guard impose it.

limits_semantics.not_guaranteed: Gaps and subsequent price/equity changes can exceed admission fractions or nominal stop losses; report and fail acceptance gates rather than silently cap losses.

qa_before_economics: Legacy receipt reproduction for native profiles
Queue-only causal ablation with unchanged targets/rounding/fees
Several entries same day after observed close
Busy-symbol rejection and simultaneous-asset shared limits
Missing bars with open exposure fail closed
Fill cash/inventory/calendar overhead reconciliation and CASH same cost
Malformed/unknown entry and receipt enum rejection
known_remaining_scope: This extension enables new causal clocks and isolated receipt ablations. It does not by itself supply a calibrated entry-partial/reject/outage/impact model or a production virtual coordinator.
requirements_note: No named 45-requirement list located in supplied paths; the existing immutable registration contains 47 source files.
